![Microneedling Derma Roller - Erase Wrinkles and Scars](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10091044-1509-0139-0000-f35132e00b91:4)
A **derma roller** is `a handheld microneedling device covered in tiny, fine stainless steel or titanium needles` . It rolls across the skin or scalp to create microscopic punctures.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y2ar5-XMqMw&t=6)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17174176031471815187,catalogid:58704434581696238,gpcid:13824514533330530546,mid:576462806788301015&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16814430138043164677,catalogid:1035317013381600391,gpcid:265720324637953772,mid:576462878616887798&ibp=oshop)

### How It Works

- **Collagen Induction:** The micro-channels trigger the body's natural wound-healing response, boosting collagen and elastin production.[[1]](https://www.saveface.co.uk/en/blog/post/the-dos-and-don-ts-of-derma-rolling)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/thebrainmazeofficial/posts/how-derma-rollers-work-derma-rollers-create-tiny-controlled-micro-channels-in-th/1026973429986250/)
- **Product Absorption:** Temporary micro-channels help topical serums, moisturizers, or hair treatments (like hyaluronic acid or minoxidil) penetrate deeper into the skin.[[1]](https://www.boots.com/sons-derma-roller-10341394)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:9770674895903686221&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/thebrainmazeofficial/posts/how-derma-rollers-work-derma-rollers-create-tiny-controlled-micro-channels-in-th/1026973429986250/)

### Common Uses & Needle Sizes

- **0.25mm – 0.5mm:** Used at home for improving skin texture, reducing fine lines, minimizing pores, and aiding scalp or beard hair growth.[[1]](https://www.amazon.co.uk/dermaroller/s?k=dermaroller)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16814430138043164677,catalogid:1035317013381600391,gpcid:265720324637953772,mid:576462878616887798&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y2ar5-XMqMw&t=6)
- **1.0mm – 1.5mm+:** Generally reserved for deeper acne scars or body treatments and usually performed in a clinical setting rather than at home.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYevbm8x-7B/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y2ar5-XMqMw&t=6)

### Popular Options & Pricing
Available at [dermoi!](https://dermoi.com/product/pharma-hermetic-ph-derma-roller/) for around £9.95.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:9770674895903686221&ibp=oshop)Available at [Pure Derma London](https://purederma.co.uk/products/derma-roller?variant=47871065981202&country=GB&currency=GBP&utm_medium=product_sync&utm_source=google&utm_content=sag_organic&utm_campaign=sag_organic&srsltid=AU7gw4W08C1hodBT7XTxuNHPe9ittQxhRmCIu2aO-6Ywi00-AbVaHkkfNks) for around £17.95.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16814430138043164677,catalogid:1035317013381600391,gpcid:265720324637953772,mid:576462878616887798&ibp=oshop)Available at [Boots.com](https://www.boots.com/kitsch-micro-derma-roller-white-10286827?srsltid=AU7gw4W_fBCZT5cfJMAV7e1cQMImHwc4LizMDX0imT63hXQjBfzSucEJto0) for around £15.00.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17174176031471815187,catalogid:58704434581696238,gpcid:13824514533330530546,mid:576462806788301015&ibp=oshop)[Sons Derma Roller](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=FAILED_OR_SKIPPED&q=Sons%20Derma%20Roller) 

Available at [Boots](https://www.boots.com/sons-derma-roller-10341394?srsltid=AU7gw4WNPVTboX2258Sq9Z6xqE_tB9Vm4dBrVlgZi79ItDTPRCVD8ncR) paired for scalp and hair thinning routines.[[1]](https://www.boots.com/sons-derma-roller-10341394)Show more

### Safety & Best Practices

- **Disinfection:** Sterilize the roller with rubbing alcohol before and after every use to prevent bacterial infections.
- **Avoid Active Acids:** Do not use harsh retinols, AHAs, or BHAs immediately alongside derma rolling to prevent severe irritation.
- **Avoid Broken Skin:** Never roll over active acne, eczema, rosacea, or sunburned skin.[[1]](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/how-to-use-a-dermaroller)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/FortisMUM/videos/derma-roller-is-a-skincare-device-covered-with-tiny-fine-needles-used-in-a-techn/1539592733889129/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/gNFpTrT0-Ac)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y2ar5-XMqMw&t=6)

If you'd like, let me know:

- **What specific concern** you want to target (acne scars, anti-aging, or hair/beard growth)
- **Where** you plan to use it (face or scalp)

I can recommend the right needle size and routine for you.
